messages:
Emily Johnson: Heads up — Harborline renewal in ~45 days (2026-05-10). Noticed platform activity down ~60% over the last 30d after their PM left. Need a quick triage and playbook recs. Key seats: 32 -> 12 active. Procurement is now owning this, no product contact. Can sales + CSM jump on? @Diego Ramos @Maya Patel
Maya Patel: Saw the same in the dashboard. I tried the PM email, no reply. Procurement said they're running a competitor trial. :thinking:
Diego Ramos: I can join a call with procurement. Any intel on why they started evaluating alternatives?
Emily Johnson: Procurement flagged pricing + missing bulk-export behavior. No systemic errors in logs. Renewal date above.
Rohan Singh: Quick infra check — no CPU/mem errors. We did push a model-quantization tweak on 2026-02-08 that reduced throughput for long-context jobs; might impact heavy export workflows. Ran this query to validate drop window:
```
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day, count(*) as calls
FROM usage.events
WHERE account_id = 'harborline'
  AND ts > now() - interval '60 days'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
```
Rohan Singh: Graph link uploaded — drop starts 2026-02-09, matches the tweak.
Priya Shah: Suggested plays: 1) Rapid ops + procurement workshop, 2) Short dedicated trial to show perf, 3) Fast-turn bulk-export plugin support. Which do we want first?
Maya Patel: I've scheduled a procurement call Thu 9am PST. @Diego, can you lead pricing options? Emily, can you pull recent eval logs and top failing prompts?
Emily Johnson: Uploaded an eval slice to /shared/harborline/evals, flagged 8 prompts with regressions. Link: https://redwood.workspaces/harborline/evals
Diego Ramos: I'll prepare a competitive snapshot — who exactly are they trialing?
Emily Johnson: Hearing VectorGrid and AtlasAI. VectorGrid pitch is cheaper embeddings + export convenience.
Priya Shah: Immediate playbook I'd recommend: spin a 2-week dedicated pool (small) + 30% off first month, run a 60‑minute tech workshop for ops to show export reliability, and offer a dev support ticket for bulk-export within SLA.
Rohan Singh: If we approve the dedicated trial, I can provision a node and bump batch limits on the export path so their historical workloads pass.
Maya Patel: Action list — @Diego pricing draft by EOD, @Rohan infra readiness by tomorrow noon, @Emily collect top10 regressions + invite ops to workshop, @Priya draft a 60min workshop agenda.
Emily Johnson: Marking risk = HIGH. I'll escalate to Sales Execs after Diego shares pricing. :pray:
oncall-bot: Reminder set — follow-up with Harborline in 3 days.
Diego Ramos: Quick Q — do we have a one-pager/reference of a similar customer who returned after a dedicated trial?
Maya Patel: Yes — AcmeHealth case study exists, I'll pull a quote and metrics.
Emily Johnson: Once Diego posts pricing I'll update the account playbook and send calendar invites.
Priya Shah: I'll start a workshop slide skeleton and include a short export performance demo.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — tight timeline but clear actions. :rocket:
